verdict.rationale: Godot is released under the permissive MIT license with 'no strings attached, no royalties, nothing.' It may be used for any purpose and redistributed commercially, and the engine's license does not apply to games made with it, which developers solely own. With no fees or royalties at all, there is nothing to reprice on shipped games. A community comment adds that Godot imposes none of the splash-screen or payment requirements of other engines. missing for 10: explicit evidence of a historical track record of unchanged terms over time, independent corroboration that terms have never been retroactively altered.
